svg.title: Cosine restricted to [0, pi] and its inverse
svg.desc: Axes from about -1.6 to 3.6. A faint full cosine curve, with the piece on [0, pi] drawn in blue, falling from (0, 1) to (pi, -1). Its reflection across the dashed line y = x, drawn in green, is the graph of inverse cosine, falling from (-1, pi) to (1, 0).
